summary: AerCap Holdings N.V. filed a Form 6-K disclosing that its board approved a share repurchase program authorizing up to $1 billion of ordinary share buybacks through June 30, 2027. Repurchases may occur via open-market or privately negotiated transactions under U.S. federal securities laws, with timing and share count at management's discretion based on market conditions, funded by cash on hand and operations. The program may be suspended or discontinued at any time, and the disclosure is incorporated by reference into AerCap's Form F-3 and S-8 registration statements. Watch execution pace, price discipline versus book value, and any leverage or capital-allocation trade-offs.
